voz.estilo: Speak in American English like a gripping documentary narrator revealing a classified file. Serious and a little mysterious, but at a brisk, energetic pace with short pauses.

frases: July 8, 1947. The FBI in Dallas sends an urgent teletype.
Hexagonal in shape, hanging from a balloon.
It resembles a weather balloon with a radar reflector.
But Wright Field did not confirm it.
It's flown out by special plane.
videos.caption: The real FBI teletype about Roswell, July 8, 1947. Read the last line. #roswell #ufo #fbi #declassified #history
